description: Boundary candidates found during the 2026-09-25 coverage investigation for the 26 sites without a published RSIS boundary and the 3 invalid RSIS geometries. NONE is imported or used for analysis; each needs confirmation by the named authority or project approval.

searched.repository: No wetland polygon for these sites; only RSIS copies and administrative boundaries (state/district/tehsil) exist.
searched.gee: Earth Engine access unavailable (no credentials; anonymous API HTTP 401). 0/74 GEE ROIs obtained.
searched.rsis: Published layer ramsar_sdi:features_published has none of the 26. All-version layers ramsar_sdi:features / features_bnd contain unnamed geometries at 14 of the 26 locations (listed below).
searched.wdpa: 54 Indian Ramsar polygons; 5 of the 26 (older source record 1856), plus a valid version of 2408.
searched.government_of_india: No public vector source of Ramsar designated boundaries found (MoEFCC Wetlands of India portal shows points; SAC NWIA atlas and India-WRIS map wetland extent, not designated boundaries).
